analysis.note: Citation edges are mechanical. A citation of B in the text of A is recorded as an edge A to B whether or not A logically depends on B: the text cites results for comparison, motivation and notation as well as for proof steps. The graph therefore over-approximates logical dependence in that respect. It can also miss dependencies: citations not written as "Kind N.M" (by section, by display, by unnumbered discussion), citations whose target is not indexed, and uses that the text does not cite at all are not edges. The critical path is therefore neither an upper nor a lower bound on what the derivation of abc uses; it is a reading list for checking that derivation.
